name: Mochizuki Satoya
source:
He acts as [url=/c43164]Kagurazaka's[/url] right hand man and is the captain of the shock corps in the Youth League. Despite not yet being in a position where he is able to help, Satoya worries about how to change the current situation somehow. A polite person, he's better at moving his body than using his head however.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/04/17/getsuei-no-kusari/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
